answer_1.quote: Text simplification is a text-to-text generation task that aims to make a text easier to read while preserving its original meaning.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating simplified versions of complex sentences, preserving meaning while improving readability.

answer_2.quote: We benchmark LENS metric against the existing automatic metrics (i) for evaluating text simplification system outputs and (ii) for training better automatic simplification models when used as alternative reward functions.

answer_4.quote: We ask in-house annotators to rate each simplification on a single 0-100 overall quality scale using our RANK & RATE framework
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated simplifications on a 0-100 continuous scale for overall quality, with support from edit highlighting and list-wise ranking to compare outputs.
